caption:
Burbn had too many features. Users only loved the photos. So the founders kept just that. 📸 Less really is more. What app do you wish would do LESS? 👇

post.news: Did you know? Instagram started as Burbn, a check-in app. The founders cut everything except photos.
post.take: They deleted most of their app and it became huge. Some of us can't even delete old selfies.
